stories.title: Israel's new parliament sworn in as rivals vie to form government
stories.summary: Israel's newly elected Knesset was sworn in Wednesday, with Benjamin Netanyahu's main rival Gadi Eisenkot handed the first chance to assemble a governing coalition. The outcome will decide whether Netanyahu returns as prime minister or is pushed out after years in office.

stories.title: Ukrainian drones hit Russia's Ust-Luga port, sparking fire and diverting flights
stories.summary: Drone strikes overnight set fire to the port zone of Ust-Luga on Russia's Baltic coast and injured three workers, Leningrad region governor Alexander Drozdenko said. The attack forced Pulkovo Airport near St Petersburg to close temporarily, diverting inbound flights to Helsinki.

stories.title: Iran designates Argentina's navy and air force as 'terrorist organizations'
stories.summary: Tehran said Wednesday it now treats Argentina's navy and air force as terrorist entities, a reciprocal move after Buenos Aires listed Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps in April. The tit-for-tat escalation comes as Washington presses allies to isolate the IRGC.

stories.title: World leaders make their pitches at COP31 as Turkey pushes a new climate deal
stories.summary: Heads of state addressed the COP31 summit in Turkey on Wednesday, setting out competing climate priorities while negotiators try to agree on a fresh framework. Turkey is pushing its own deal text as talks run against the clock.

stories.title: AI agent swarm may have found an unmapped Maya site in Mexico
stories.summary: Google researcher Pietro Miotti says 48 AI agents combing NASA lidar data flagged signs of an unrecorded ancient site in Mexico, and Mexico's national archaeology institute has replied. The find still needs fieldwork to confirm, but it's an early example of agents doing real discovery work.

stories.title: Google extends Gmail's 'Help me write' AI to Workspace work accounts
stories.summary: Google is rolling out Gemini-powered 'Help me write' to all Workspace users 18 and older over the next two weeks, and expanding AI conversation summaries that synthesize key points and replies. It pushes generative AI deeper into workplace email, where compliance and data-handling concerns are sharper.

stories.title: OpenAI says 20,000 veterans have claimed a free year of ChatGPT Plus
stories.summary: Ahead of Veterans Day, OpenAI said more than 20,000 transitioning service members and veterans have claimed a free year of ChatGPT Plus, backed by ID.me verification. The company is pairing the offer with job-transition training events through its Academy program.

stories.title: Browns stand pat at the trade deadline with all four quarterbacks still on the roster
stories.summary: Cleveland made no trades before Tuesday's 4 p.m. deadline, keeping Deshaun Watson, Shedeur Sanders, Dillon Gabriel and Taylen Green on the 53-man roster. The inaction leaves the QB picture unresolved ahead of Sunday's home game against Houston.

stories.title: Browns' depth chart still lists Watson over Sanders as Monken stays quiet
stories.summary: Cleveland's unofficial depth chart released Tuesday keeps Deshaun Watson ahead of Shedeur Sanders, but coach Todd Monken has declined to name a starter for Sunday's game against the Texans. Watson cleared concussion protocol over the weekend after Sanders threw for 297 yards and two touchdowns in the overtime loss at New Orleans.

stories.title: Robert Griffin III says Shedeur Sanders should be Cleveland's starting QB
stories.summary: On his Outta Pocket podcast, the former Browns quarterback argued Sanders gives Cleveland explosive plays Watson hasn't, pointing to 60- and 64-yard gains against the Saints. ESPN has reported Watson will start Sunday in Houston, making this weekend a referendum on the call.

stories.title: Urban Meyer: Ohio State is 'still in the hunt'; Tressel says 'never say never' on CFP
stories.summary: Meyer told The Triple Option that everything is still on the table for the 6-3 Buckeyes over their final three regular-season games, while Jim Tressel argued a three-loss team can still factor into the 12-team playoff. Ohio State sits at No. 20 in the CFP rankings but No. 4 in SP+.

stories.title: Ryan Day commits to his current coaching staff after firing special teams coordinator
stories.summary: Day said he is not planning further staff changes this season after Monday's dismissal of special teams coordinator Robby Discher, with analyst Rob Keys now running the unit. He also reaffirmed Luke Fahey as the starter against Northwestern despite back-to-back double-digit losses.

stories.title: Ohio State's path back to the CFP is improbable but not impossible
stories.summary: Ten teams have climbed from No. 20 or worse into the top 12 within four weeks, but several factors work against the Buckeyes. Their cleanest route: win out, have Oregon lose once, plus USC beating Indiana and UCLA beating USC.

stories.title: Ohio State falls to No. 20 in CFP rankings, its lowest ever
stories.summary: The second College Football Playoff rankings put the 6-3 Buckeyes at No. 20, the lowest CFP position in program history and their worst AP standing since September 2014. Analytics still like Ohio State, ranking it No. 4 in SP+ and No. 5 in ESPN's FPI.

stories.title: Toto Wolff: Antonelli isn't Senna yet, but he may be a 'Senninha'
stories.summary: Mercedes boss Toto Wolff compared his new world champion Kimi Antonelli to Ayrton Senna while cautioning against overstating the parallel. The remark lands as Mercedes celebrates the constructors' title and Antonelli heads toward the Las Vegas-Qatar-Abu Dhabi finale.

stories.title: F1 drops Imola as a backup finale with no plan B if the Iran war escalates
stories.summary: F1 told Imola on the November 10 deadline that it would not be needed as an alternative season closer, so 2026 will finish with Las Vegas, Qatar and Abu Dhabi as planned. Officials concede there is no fallback if the Middle East conflict worsens before early December.

stories.title: FIA confirms no extra engine upgrades in final ADUO review
stories.summary: The FIA's third and final ADUO analysis found performance gaps shifted but granted no additional homologations to any power unit manufacturer. Mercedes, Ferrari, Audi and Honda keep the upgrade tokens they were already awarded for 2026 and 2027.

stories.title: Honda at a loss to explain Lance Stroll's 13th DNF of the season
stories.summary: Honda says it cannot yet pin down the cause of Stroll's latest retirement in Brazil, his 13th of the 2026 campaign. The recurring failures have wrecked Aston Martin's season and raised questions about the works power unit's reliability.

stories.title: Man shot and killed near Greenlawn Cemetery in Franklinton
stories.summary: Columbus police were called to Sullivant and Brehl avenues just before 10:45 p.m. Tuesday and found a man shot; he died about an hour later at the hospital. No suspects have been identified and the investigation is ongoing.

stories.title: Woman accused of running two brothels out of a Hilltop home after SWAT raid
stories.summary: Columbus police arrested Gina Lizeth Cortes Caicedo on Monday after a SWAT operation on W. Mound Street, alleging she operated two brothels on the city's West Side. Neighbors told investigators the activity had been visible for months.

stories.title: ComFest's future in doubt after 50-plus years as costs outrun revenue
stories.summary: Organizers of the volunteer-run Columbus festival say rising costs and falling revenue could make next summer its last. They are surveying attendees and hunting for new funding and grants.

stories.title: Ohio law enforcement groups seek a compromise to keep Flock cameras running
stories.summary: The state FOP, sheriffs' association, police chiefs and prosecutors asked lawmakers for misuse penalties, vendor accountability and mandatory audits rather than an outright ban on Flock license plate readers. Several central Ohio agencies, including Columbus police, have paused the technology amid misconduct allegations.
